subject: License the code under Apache-2.0 and keep data and docs CC0
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-03 that ImintEngine's original source code is licensed under Apache-2.0, while data, documentation and other non-code material stay CC0-1.0, and third-party material keeps its own licences; copyright line 'Copyright 2026 RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB'. Scope: LICENSE becomes Apache-2.0, the CC0 text moves to LICENSE-DATA, a NOTICE, the README licensing section, notebooks/README.md, pyproject license metadata, and the image licence labels in CI (which wrongly said MIT). Not in scope: per-file SPDX headers, regenerating the showcase report footer. Review: Codex.
